title: Daemon: hot-reload workspaces + fix registration timeout
description:
Workspaces added via `sutra workspaces add` after the daemon is running are invisible to the scheduler and time out on `sutra_status`. Three related fixes, all touching `daemon.rs` + `mcp.rs` and the shared `Arc<RwLock<WorkspacesConfig>>`:

**1. Reload workspaces.toml periodically (~15-25 lines)**
`check_stale_workspaces` (daemon.rs:265) only reads the in-memory snapshot. Re-read `workspaces.toml` at the top of each scheduler tick and update the Arc if it changed. This also drops workspaces removed from config (e.g. manas was removed but the daemon kept reparsing it).

**2. Verify timed-out registrations get picked up (~0-5 lines)**
POST-registered workspaces that time out in `try_daemon_register` may already work — `last_parse_time() == None` maps to `is_stale = true` in the scheduler. Verify this path works; if the sentinel isn't written in all timeout paths, add it.

**3. Increase or remove the 10s status timeout (~3-5 lines)**
`try_daemon_register` in `mcp.rs:901-928` has a hardcoded `for _ in 0..10` loop (1s sleep × 10). vidya takes 14s to parse. Either increase to match `parse_timeout_sec` config (default 60s), or return a `parse_pending` status immediately and let the caller retry.

Repro: `sutra workspaces add vidya ...` while daemon running → `sutra_status` times out → workspace is zombie (registered but unparsed, scheduler ignores it)."

acceptance_criteria.text: Workspaces added to workspaces.toml after daemon start appear in the next scheduler tick without daemon restart
Workspaces removed from workspaces.toml are dropped from the scheduler (not reparsed indefinitely)
sutra_status for a new workspace with 14s parse time succeeds (either blocks long enough or returns pending status)
POST-registered workspaces whose initial parse timed out are reparsed on the next scheduler tick
